newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's government had talks with trade unions on planned social protection package. Labour leaders said after the meeting that the government had failed to present concrete proposals.

* The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) signed a deal pledging to grant up to $ 200 million in exchange for shares in Romania's telephone utility Romtelecom to finance projects to privatise and develop the utility.

* Talks with international lenders on resumed credits for Romania are expected to end next week, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said. The government would issue a package of social protection measures next week, he said.
* Romania's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by 4.1 percent in 1995, National Statistics Board data showed on Friday.
